issues.legal_issue: A statutory first charge for tax debts on a debtor’s property takes priority over a mortgage created before the charge, and extends to the property as a whole rather than only the debtor’s equity of redemption.
material_facts: A bank had taken a mortgage over a business’s factory premises as security for advances before the tax authority’s statutory first charge came into force.
The business owed sales tax, and the tax authority claimed priority over the bank in the proceeds from the court-ordered sale of the mortgaged premises.
The governing law made tax and other amounts due under the tax legislation a first charge on the property of the person liable to pay them.
issues.conclusion: The statutory first charge had priority over the earlier mortgage and operated on the entire property, including the mortgagee’s interest, rather than only on the equity of redemption.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 11-AAAA of the Rajasthan Sales Tax Act, 1954, tax and other sums payable under that Act are a first charge on the liable person’s property. Sections 58 and 100 of the Transfer of Property Act distinguish a mortgage, which transfers an interest in specific immovable property as security, from a charge; a charge is wider and includes a mortgage. Relying on Dattatreya Shanker Mote v. Anand Chintaman Datar, the Court held that a charge on property reaches the property despite a prior mortgage, and that a statutory first charge therefore takes priority over that mortgage. The Court also referred to Fisher and Lightwood’s Law of Mortgage and Westminster City Council v. Haymarket Publishing Ltd. in support of the priority of a statutory charge over an existing mortgage.

rule.if: sale_proceeds_priority_dispute and competing_claims_on_same_property and law_makes_tax_debt_a_first_charge_on_owner_property and mortgage_predates_tax_charge

predicates.sale_proceeds_priority_dispute: A dispute arises over the priority of claims to proceeds from the sale of property.
predicates.competing_claims_on_same_property: A tax authority and a mortgagee assert claims against the same property.
predicates.law_makes_tax_debt_a_first_charge_on_own: The governing law makes tax debts owed by a property owner a first charge on that owner’s property.
predicates.mortgage_predates_tax_charge: The mortgagee created its mortgage before the statutory charge arose.

issues.definition: When a dispute over sale proceeds involves competing claims to the same property, a law making the owner’s tax debt a first charge on that property, and a mortgage created before the charge, the statutory first charge takes priority and covers the entire property.
